message: Water reached 4 feet inside the ground floor. Grandmother is diabetic and needs insulin urgently. Baby needs infant milk formula.
We are 12 residents stranded on rooftop. Water is rising fast. Generator failed, oxygen concentrator offline.
Roof blown away by gale winds. We urgently require tarpaulins and clean drinking water.
Is the bridge on NH-45 open for cars? When will local electricity be restored?
